newsitem.title: UK: Matthew Clark up on marketing drive report.
newsitem.headline: Matthew Clark up on marketing drive report.

text.p: Shares in Matthew Clark Plc rose on Monday after a report in the Financial Times on Saturday said the company was poised to launch a campaign to revive its Diamond White and Dry Blackthorn cider brands.
The stock was up 8-1/2p at 313-1/2 by 0956 GMT after rising as high as 317, its highest since the end of October.

Matthew Clark shares plummetted last September after the company warned that its sales were being hit by rising sales of so-called "alcopops." The FT said the announcement of the new marketing drive was aimed at restoring investor confidence.
Clark announces first-half results tomorrow and the FT said the company would also bring analysts and investors up to date on progress in hiring a new chairman and marketing director.

However the paper said the company would have work hard to counter fears that aggressive cost-cutting had "hollowed out" the company and lessened its marketing impact, making its brands vulnerable to the swing towards alcopops.
The FT said Clark had hired an innovative consultancy called Red Spider to beef up its cider brands.
